algorithm: {The proposed algorithm is a sequential variant of the Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (CMA-ES) that incorporates local search and cliping to bounded domain, tailored for minimization of high-dimensional functions with known bounds on variables.}

{This is a Hybrid Differential Evolution (DE) and Simulated Annealing (SA) algorithm that combines the global search capabilities of DE with the local search abilities of SA to efficiently explore the solution space and find the optimal solution.}
